paper.title: Product Type {Simpson}'s Integration
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 15(12), Dec 1972, p. 1070; collected as TOMS Algorithm 437
paper.url: https://netlib.org/toms/437.gz (ACM article not read; ACM pages return 403 from this host)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 437.gz (fetched by scout 2026-11-27 into a fresh /tmp directory; decompressed and read as text, not executed). sha256 3d5d67394e0a50131e5eaf60cdfff518c41e7e70b86e01f27e9eeaf65090f3ce
code.note: Shell archive containing Fortran/Dp/Drivers (Makefile, driver.f, res) and Fortran/Dp/Src/src.f (the product Simpson routine). The driver test01 and test02 loop over N=1..10 and print VINT with format g14.6; res is the shipped reference output of that driver.

claim.location: Shipped reference output res (member Fortran/Dp/Drivers/res inside 437.gz). Claim row: TEST02 (integral of exp(-x)*cos(x) from 0 to pi, product Simpson), N = 10, VINT = 0.521610.

reference.sha256: not computed for the member; the value is quoted here and compared as a number

claim.metric: VINT for TEST02 at N=10, as printed by the driver (g14.6, six significant digits).
claim.paper_value: The paper's table is not read (ACM 403). The value is the shipped reference output res, written by the authors' driver; the exact integral printed there is 0.521607.

tolerance.basis: The reference is printed to six significant digits, so its rounding half-unit is 5e-7. 1e-6 absolute covers that rounding and any compiler ordering difference in double precision; a wrong weight or node in the product rule moves VINT by far more. Fixed now, before any run; not to be loosened after a run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute: a few hundred function evaluations.
cost.data_size: None; the integrand is in the driver.
cost.data_licence: No data. Source is the public netlib TOMS collected-algorithms archive.

why: The driver runs the product Simpson rule on a non-trivial oscillatory-exponential integrand over a range of N, so a rerun must compile the Fortran and reproduce the table; the value is not a closed form at N=10.
